purpose: Larger paired validation of the F8-selected curved-only static force-action cap (+0.50) against control on independent, previously unused surface seeds. No training, no integration, no release changes.

arms.static_cap: curved-only force action <= +0.50 (STATIC_FORCE_ACTION_CAP in learning/rl/gate_f8_force_safety.py); flat is exact action passthrough

executor: learning/rl/gate_f8_force_safety_eval.py reused unmodified; one invocation per (arm, geometry, direction, seed base)
seed_base_provenance: audited results directory names and gate metadata on 2026-09-01; no prior gate used any 40000-series surface seed base (F6 used 31000, F7 used 32000, F8 used 33000)
pairing_contract: for every (geometry, direction, seed base, profile) the control and static_cap sequences must exist and share an identical profile_seed; pair keys must be unique across the whole official sample

final_gate.entry_curved_safety_pass_candidate_gt_co: cylinder+freeform, both directions, all four seed bases
final_gate.flat_action_passthrough_parity: all paired flat sequence rows identical on the frozen F8 parity field list

interpretation_notes: The curved-safety-improvement check is strict (candidate > control on cylinder+freeform). If control shows no curved safety failure on these independent seeds, the gate fails by design and is reported as-is; thresholds are not relaxed after results exist.

Curved control sequences may terminate early on hard force overload, so raw mean control-step comparisons are censored. Time comparisons are reported both raw (labeled censored) and over uncensored pairs where both arms finished without any hard violation. Early termination is never reported as a speedup.
A PASS makes static_cap an integration candidate only. Actual integration/release is a separately approved stage (F10 recommended).
stop_rules: do not change thresholds, cap value, seeds, or candidate definitions after seeing results
no BC/PPO training, no reward changes
no champion or release modification, no automatic promotion
do not delete or overwrite any existing results; preserve accidental duplicate runs and exclude them from official counts after hash verification
protected files remain untouched: scripts/polishing_v5.py, scripts/polishing_v5_modules/, learning/rl/env/polish_env.py, learning/rl/env/polish_env_cfg.py, existing champion/release checkpoints
